title: L0 Review: Show What You Know
story: You've come so far! From printing "Hello World" to loops, strings, math, and decisions. Now it's time to combine everything you've learned into one awesome showcase program — a personal profile builder that uses variables, math, strings, conditions, AND loops!
why: Real programs combine many concepts at once — this review proves you can think like a real programmer and piece everything together.
analogy: Building a program that uses everything is like cooking a meal with all the skills you learned — chopping, mixing, baking, and seasoning all come together on one plate.
expected_output:
Player: ALEX
Try again!
Your name has 4 letters.
try_it: Add one more variable to the showcase (like `let lucky_number: Int = 7;`) and one more calculation (multiply your score by your lucky number at the end). Make it YOUR program!
tips: If something doesn't work, check your curly braces `{}` — every `{` needs a matching `}`
Re-read code you wrote earlier in L0 — your own past solutions are the best reference!
Experiment fearlessly! Change numbers, add variables, combine concepts. Breaking things teaches you more than playing it safe
common_mistakes: Trying to use a variable before creating it — always declare with `let` or `var` first!
Forgetting that `let` variables can't change — if you need to update something in a loop, use `var`
